response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value;
